settings.label: Partition
settings.help: Slurm partition (queue) for every job, or a comma-separated list Slurm may choose from. Empty uses the cluster's default. List them with `sinfo -s`.

settings.label: Account
settings.help: Account (project) charged for the jobs, passed as -A. TRUBA and UHeM require it; UHeM lists yours with `projelerim`, other sites with `sacctmgr show assoc user=$USER format=account`.

settings.label: Submit without an account
settings.help: Passes --slurm-no-account for clusters that have no accounts. The 2.8.0 executor plugin defines the flag but does not yet act on it: with no account it still tries to guess one and submits without -A when that fails.

settings.label: Quality of service
settings.help: QOS name passed as --qos, where the site requires one.

settings.label: Node features
settings.help: Feature expression passed as --constraint, e.g. a node type such as orfoz on TRUBA's debug queue.

settings.label: Cluster
settings.help: For federated sites: the cluster name passed as --clusters.

settings.label: Reservation
settings.help: An advance reservation the jobs should run in.

settings.label: Exclude nodes
settings.help: Nodes never to use, e.g. a017,a[040-042].

settings.label: Other sbatch options
settings.help: Further options such as --nice=10 or --mail-type=FAIL. Options the settings above or the executor manage (account, partition, QOS, memory, CPUs, time, output) are refused here.

settings.label: Jobs in the queue at once
settings.help: Maximum number of jobs submitted at the same time. Keep it below the site's per-user limit.

settings.label: Minimum CPUs per job
settings.help: Smallest CPU request of any job (0 = each step's own thread count). Set it to the partition's minimum where one exists, e.g. TRUBA orfoz 56, hamsi 28, barbun 20.

settings.label: Default walltime (min)
settings.help: Walltime of a step with no walltime of its own (see the per-step table).

settings.label: Default memory floor (MB)
settings.help: Memory of a step that declares none: the larger of this and twice the step's input size.

settings.label: Retries
settings.help: Times a failed job is submitted again. A retry asks for the attempt number times the walltime (the step's own or the default one), capped by the walltime cap when set.

settings.label: Walltime cap (min)
settings.help: Upper bound for a retried job's walltime (0 = no cap). Set it to the partition's time limit.

settings.label: Memory cap for retries (MB)
settings.help: When set, a retried job also asks for more memory, up to this value (e.g. the node's memory). 0 keeps the memory of a retry unchanged.

settings.label: Temporary directory
settings.help: Absolute directory for each job's temporary files (STAR and samtools sort spill). Empty keeps the node's own. Quotes and '$' are not accepted, so a variable cannot be used here.

settings.label: Requeue
settings.help: site-default leaves it to the cluster; requeue lets Slurm restart a job after a node failure or pre-emption; no-requeue forbids it.

settings.label: Job-state command
settings.help: auto uses sacct when present. Choose squeue on a cluster without job accounting.

settings.label: Submit as job arrays
settings.help: Empty, all, or comma-separated step or rule names whose jobs are grouped into Slurm job arrays (a step name such as fastp covers every rule that reads its settings).

settings.label: Array size limit
settings.help: Largest array per submission (0 = the executor's default).

settings.label: Job-name prefix
settings.help: Prefix shown in squeue (letters, digits, _ and -).

settings.label: Pass commands as scripts
settings.help: Feeds each job's command to sbatch on standard input, for sites with a short command-line limit.

settings.label: Efficiency report
settings.help: Writes logs/slurm/efficiency_report_<run id>.csv with each job's CPU and memory use at the end of the run.

settings.label: Partition limits file
settings.help: Optional YAML file (path relative to the project) describing partition limits, so the executor chooses a partition for each job by its size.

settings.label: Shared-filesystem wait (s)
settings.help: How long to wait for a finished job's output to appear on the shared filesystem.

settings.label: Login-node cores
settings.help: Cores the steps that run on the submitting host may use together (downloads, enrichment).

settings.label: Run online steps on the login node
settings.help: Downloads, GEO retrieval, enrichment, STRING and the MSigDB Hallmark set run where the run was started, because compute nodes often have no internet.

settings.label: Compute nodes have internet
settings.help: Single-allocation mode only: when false, the job leaves the online steps, and the figures, check summary and reports that depend on them, for a finishing run on the login node.

settings.label: CPUs
settings.help: CPUs of the one job (0 = the whole node, --exclusive).

settings.label: Memory (GB)
settings.help: Memory of the one job (0 = all of the node's memory).

settings.label: Walltime (min)
settings.help: Walltime of the one job. A run that needs longer is continued by submitting the script again.

settings.label: Container image
settings.help: Apptainer/Singularity image (.sif) to run the workflow in, for sites that forbid conda installs. Empty runs the installed environment.

settings.label: Container command
settings.help: apptainer or singularity, whichever the cluster provides.

settings.label: Container bind paths
settings.help: Further directories the container must see, comma-separated absolute paths. The project folder, the temporary directory and the folders of the configured reference and FASTQ files are bound already.
